subject: general
question: Forest Research Institute of India is located at_______
solution:
Correct answer is__** Dehradun.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• It is situated at **Dehradun in Uttarakhand**, and is among the **oldest institutions of its type.**
 
• The Forest Research Institute (FRI) started in 1906, is **a pioneer institute in the field of environmental and forestry research**.
 
• The Forest Research Institute (FRI) is an institute of the Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education.
 
• **Forest Research Institute (FRI), Dehradun** made a humble starting as Forest School established in **1878**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a49b73903c37693c3f1f5d9fa62ee5835500ab12fa24e692ea2f914d1d82632.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Kerala Forest Research Institute is an organisation based in Peechi, in Thrissur, India. 
 
• **Himalayan Forest Research Institute (HFRI)** is a Research institute situated in **Shimla in Himachal Pradesh**.​ 
 
• Guwahati is **an important river port and Assam's principal commercial centre**.
